spanish: Y el que no acechó, y Dios lo hizo encontrar a su mano, y pondré a ti lugar adonde huirá allá.

findings.issue: «lo» is an unmarked supplied 3ms object. The piel has no object suffix and no object token; only God causes the meeting or befalling.

notes: לְיָדוֹ stays the prepositional goal «a su mano»; the other clauses stay within the tokens.
